annotations.title: Check a page for broken links

description: Check every link on one web page: up to 50 of them (the site's own first, at most 10 on any other site), each asked once for its status — broken (4xx, 5xx), unreachable or redirecting — plus http:// links on an https page and links with no text or "click here" text, each check pass / improve / fix with how to fix it. It fetches the page and each link's headers as our crawler (MakerRadarBot), after each host's robots.txt, and stores nothing. at most 20 checks an hour per network and 30 an hour per site checked.

url.description: The public page to check (https://…). A bare host means its homepage.

name: check_links

checks.description: Fails first. `fix` is the one action to take; null on a pass.

facts.description: What was read, as labelled rows. From the site or a registry: unverified.

listing.description: Whether the site is listed on the directory: its page when it is (and claimUrl while nobody has proven they own it), where to list it when not.

toolUrl.description: The same check as a page on the site.
